abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Energy Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 1 Energy card from your hand. Then draw up to 3 cards from your deck. This power can't be used if Delcatty is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Max Energy Source
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Active Pokémon.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Psy Shadow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a {Psychic} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Energy Burst
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the total amount of Energy attached to Gardevoir and the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.label: Poké-Power
abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have basic Energy cards in your discard pile, you may discard any 1 card from your hand. Then search for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. You can't return the card you first discarded to your hand in this way. This power can't be used if Magneton is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Magnetic Force
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Pokémon (including Magneton).

attacks.name: Removal Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Strike and Run
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. You may switch Dunsparce with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sudden Flash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, each Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Psychic Boom
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Catch
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

text.name: Warp Point
effect: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.

text.name: Ancient Tomb
effect: Don't apply Weakness for all Pokémon in play (excluding Pokémon-ex and Pokémon that has an owner in its name).

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

text.name: Pokémon Reversal
effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.

text.name: Rare Candy
effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.)

text.name: Magnetic Storm
effect: Any damage done by attacks from {Psychic} Pokémon and {Fighting} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is not affected by Resistance.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

text.name: Steven's Advice
effect: Draw a number of cards up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
If you have more than 7 cards (including this one) in your hand, you can't play this card.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Feedback
attacks.text: Count the number of cards in your opponent's hand. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psystorm
attacks.text: Does 10 damage times the total amount of Energy attached to all Pokémon in play.

rules.label: Pokémon-ex rule
rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Desert Shaman
effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck and draw up to 4 cards. Your opponent does the same.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Town Volunteers
effect: Take 5 Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards from your discard pile and then show them to your opponent. Shuffle them into your deck.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Oracle
effect: Choose 2 cards from your deck and shuffle the rest of your deck. Put the chosen cards on top of your deck in any order.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Weakness Guard
effect: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard it at the end of your opponent's next turn.
As long as this card is attached, this Pokémon has no Weakness.

text.name: Boost Energy
effect: Boost Energy can be attached only to an Evolved Pokémon. Discard Boost Energy at the end of the turn it was attached. Boost Energy provides {Colorless}{Colorless}{Colorless} Energy. The Pokémon Boost Energy is attached to can't retreat. When the Pokémon Boost Energy is attached to is no longer an Evolved Pokémon, discard Boost Energy.

text.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.
